name: loopx
description: Staged workflow checks for AI coding agents: requirement interview, spec, review gates, test design, implementation, validation and release readiness with a local state controller.

interface.shortDescription: Quality gates for AI coding agents
interface.longDescription: LoopX forces risky AI coding work through a staged workflow: requirement interview, spec drafting, human-confirmed reviews, test planning, implementation, and release checks. A local controller persists run state and locks business writes until review gates pass.
